titles.romaji: Love Live! Superstar!! Season 3 NHK E Tokubetsu Part
titles.native: ラブライブ!スーパースター!! 3期 特別パート

description: Weekly animated segments shown with each Love Live! Superstar!! Season 3 episode exclusively on the NHK Educational TV (NHK E) broadcast of the TV anime. Unlike prior seasons only six of the twelve episodes contained the usual Liella no Uta segment. The other six episodes featured various other animated segments. These shorts will later be released across all 6 volumes of the Blu-ray/DVD releases of Love Live! Superstar!! 3.
